name: CB6 context-independent development root
purpose: Make repository state, not chat memory, elapsed time, task switching, summaries, or operator recollection, the complete authority required to start or resume CB6 development.
start_rule: BLOCK unless repository-only reconstruction proves every required output is present, internally consistent, and current.
completion_rule: BLOCK unless the frozen method survives context-loss, historical-incident, unknown-change, independent-verification, extensibility, artifact-identity, and device-evidence tests without method modification.

certification.authority: root certification must be proven mechanically; this status alone never opens feature execution
